need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, since Composio provides a managed Todoist app. For launch you will likely want your own app so users see your brand and you get a dedicated quota.

prerequisites.title: Verified Todoist account
prerequisites.detail: Check you have a verified Todoist user account before certification. Todoist says it can help if you need a Pro account for development.

prerequisites.title: Privacy policy and HTTPS links
prerequisites.detail: Certification needs a privacy policy URL and HTTPS links; submission fields must be in English.

steps.title: Create app in App Management Console
steps.detail: Log in to Todoist and create the app. Note the Client ID and Client Secret.
steps.done_when: You have a Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Register redirect URI
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and add it in the console. If you have multiple redirect URIs, your authorization request must include redirect_uri.
steps.done_when: Redirect URI is saved in the console.

steps.title: Pick minimal scopes
steps.detail: Choose the narrowest scopes, for example data:read or task:add. Restricted first-party scopes are rejected.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom Todoist auth config through Composio's API with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test user can connect.

steps.title: Prepare certification materials
steps.detail: Draft the description (including the not-affiliated statement), installation instructions, and a demo script. Prepare a JPG icon on white and 1600x1000 JPG screenshots.
steps.done_when: All form fields drafted in English.

steps.title: Record demo and submit form
steps.detail: Record the demo video and submit the certification form.

steps.title: Wait for Todoist review
steps.detail: Todoist aims to respond with feedback within ten business days and to answer emails within two.
steps.done_when: Listing is published with a public link.

traps.title: Todoist cannot be the primary app name
traps.detail: Use a name like 'x for Todoist' and state your app is not created by, affiliated with, or supported by Todoist. Follow the brand guidelines for any logo use.

traps.title: Token limit can break user connections
traps.detail: If the app exceeds the maximum token limit or is suspended for abuse, users are redirected with an invalid_application_status error. The limit value was not found.

traps.title: Meeting criteria does not guarantee certification
traps.detail: Todoist says the published criteria are representative but do not guarantee passing.

traps.title: Webhooks only activate after user OAuth
traps.detail: A user's webhook becomes active only when that user completes your app's OAuth flow. Webhook URLs must use HTTPS and no port.

traps.title: Some features depend on user plan
traps.detail: The API is free, but some features depend on the plan of the developer or authenticated user, such as backups.
